// Copied from backend/src/services/authority/authority-integrity-repair.service.ts lines 376-396 (Planning Tool)
export async function repairOrganizationAuthority(clients: any, input: any, unit: any, orphanAssignments: any[]) { // fixture wrapper
  await clients.local.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.authorityAssignment.updateMany({
      where: { id: { in: orphanAssignments.map((row) => row.id) } },
      data: { active: false, revision: { increment: 1 } },
    });
    await tx.auditEvent.create({
      data: {
        domain: 'SYSTEM',
        action: 'ORG_AUTHORITY_REPAIRED',
        entityType: 'ORG_UNIT_AUTHORITY',
        entityId: unit.id,
        oldValue: JSON.stringify({ orphanAssignmentIds: orphanAssignments.map((row) => row.id) }),
        newValue: JSON.stringify({ managerId: null, repaired: true }),
        actorId: input.actor.employeeId,
        timestamp: new Date(),
        contextId: input.idempotencyKey,
        idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey,
        severity: 'WARN',
      },
    });
  });
} // fixture wrapper
